Parts.Description: Deep-blue night paving with moss lawns and a gold star medallion under the Galaxy Shiba.
Parts.Name: Starfield Plaza

Parts.Description: A navy board on two posts that spells OBSERVATORY in gold block letters for everyone on the road.
Parts.Name: Observatory Sign

Parts.Description: A white and brass refractor telescope on a stone plinth, tube raised to the stars.
Parts.Name: Garden Refractor

Parts.Description: A stone sundial with a brass plate and a golden pointer, set between the winding paths.
Parts.Name: Star Sundial

Parts.Description: Four lamp posts of different heights with warm lanterns and a stone bench between them.
Parts.Name: Lamp Grove

Parts.Description: A white moon rover with four wheels, a blue solar panel, a mast and a small dish.
Parts.Name: Moon Rover

Parts.Description: Three wooden loungers with purple cushions tipped back at different angles for watching the sky.
Parts.Name: Stargazer Loungers

Parts.Description: A purple coffee cart with a red and white striped awning serving star-shaped cookies.
Parts.Name: Cosmic Cafe

Parts.Description: A wide crater ringed with grey rocks and a burnt meteor lying in the middle.
Parts.Name: Meteor Crater

Parts.Description: A huge dark meteorite resting on a stone plinth with a smaller chunk beside it.
Parts.Name: Meteorite Plinth

Parts.Description: A brass model of the solar system with a golden sun and coloured planets on turning rings.
Parts.Name: Brass Orrery

Parts.Description: A ring of tall standing stones with lintels around a low altar that marks the solstice.
Parts.Name: Star Henge

Parts.Description: A gold-foil lunar lander with four splayed legs and a ladder, parked on the plaza.
Parts.Name: Lunar Lander

Parts.Description: A wooden deck with three small telescopes on tripods, each aimed at another corner of the sky.
Parts.Name: Telescope Terrace

Parts.Description: A cluster of tall violet crystals of different sizes growing out of a rocky base.
Parts.Name: Moon Crystals

Parts.Description: A golden comet head with a tail of fading coloured balls streaking across a stone plinth.
Parts.Name: Comet Sculpture

Parts.Description: A gold satellite with blue solar wings and a dish, shown on a stone display stand.
Parts.Name: Satellite Display

Parts.Description: Three radio dishes of different sizes on masts, all listening to a different part of the sky.
Parts.Name: Dish Field

Parts.Description: A white rocket with a red nose and fins on its stand, a steel gantry beside it.
Parts.Name: Launch Rocket

Parts.Description: A round stone fountain with a golden sun on a column and little planets circling on brass rings.
Parts.Name: Planet Fountain

Parts.Description: A white astronaut on a stone pedestal, one arm raised, a red flag planted behind.
Parts.Name: Astronaut Statue

Parts.Description: A glass greenhouse with a stepped roof and rows of purple night flowers.
Parts.Name: Moon Greenhouse

Parts.Description: A big white radio dish on a steel tower that swings over a little control cabin.
Parts.Name: Great Dish

Parts.Description: A tall silver dome tower with an open slit, a small entrance and a thin lightning mast on top.
Parts.Name: Silver Dome

Parts.Description: A white hall with a big dome, a pillared entrance and a golden finial where the stars are shown.
Parts.Name: Planetarium

Parts.Description: A white control building with a glass front, a stepped control room and a mast with a dish.
Parts.Name: Mission Control

Parts.Description: A golden star held inside three crossing brass rings on a stone base.
Parts.Name: Armillary Sphere

Parts.Description: The main observatory: a huge silver dome on a stone drum with a telescope aimed out of the slit.
Parts.Name: Great Dome

Parts.Description: A tall slim lattice tower with an observation deck, a silver pod and a red-tipped mast.
Parts.Name: Beacon Spire

Parts.Description: The showpiece: a golden spiral galaxy with violet arms turning above a dark plinth.
Parts.Name: Spiral Galaxy
